svg.title: An entity's rows are what edges can name
svg.desc: An entity node lists fields as rows; an edge's from_field or to_field names a row, and describe reads both compactly.

text.tspan: An entity's rows are what edges can name

g.desc: fields, from_field, and to_field are appended at the end of Element and of the contract's field list, so sibling branches that append their own fields conflict trivially.
pk,fk covers a join table's columns, which are both. A name is unique within its entity and at most 64 characters on one line.
The SVG edge carries data-from-field and data-to-field; each entity row is a <g data-field>, so a reader can match them.
Names or types with spaces, commas, or quotes are quoted, so the list stays unambiguous.

text.tspan: fields: id uuid pk, customer_id uuid fk
A repeated or blank field, an unknown key, more rows than the
height holds, or an edge naming a field its entity does not list.
